summary.headline: Eleutherios Zebelenos on Lifespans
summary.text: Astrological judgments attributed to Apomasar concern Saturn and Mars, divine indications, travel abroad, and planetary positions. A fragment of Eleutherios Zebelenos then introduces a small horoscope for determining lifespan, using the Sun, Moon, Mars as apheta, Venus, and Jupiter as anareta.
